headlines.title: Port Of Los Angeles Reports Lowest Emissions Per Container On Record
headlines.content_summary: The Port of Los Angeles continued to make clean air gains in 2025, recording its lowest emissions per container on record, according to the Port’s newly released Inventory of Air Emissions.
